download_1gb_sample_archive: download a ~1GB sample of improvised dev data using selective archives from HuggingFace
download_single_batch: download a complete batch of ~50-100GB improvised dev data from HuggingFace
download_multiple_batches: download multiple batches of training data for model training and large-scale analysis
download_different_splits: download samples from different improvised and naturalistic splits including dev and test
download_whole_dataset: download the complete ~27TB seamless interaction dataset with confirmation prompt
